recipe.title: Greek chicken bowl with yogurt sauce
steps: Season the chicken with oregano, salt and pepper. Bake at 200 C for 25 minutes, then rest and slice.
Cook the rice and let it cool.
Cut the cucumber and tomato. Crumble the feta.
Stir the yogurt with a pinch of salt and oregano for the sauce.
Store the chicken, rice, vegetables, feta and sauce in separate containers. Build each bowl at work and reheat the chicken and rice in the microwave.
